finalText:
**4.2.0 is drafted in `CHANGELOG.md`.**

Out of 380 commits, one real feature and eleven fixes stood out. Everything else was dependency bumps, refactors, tests, and CI.

One new thing: webhook deliveries now retry themselves with backoff instead of just failing.

The fixes worth knowing: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403`, full request bodies stopped going into logs, and pagination stopped crashing on a null cursor across four different endpoints. The rest are smaller: duplicate headers, lost trace ids, wrong histogram units, doubled trailing slashes, empty allowlists erroring, and a slow-to-hang HTTP client. Several hot paths also got noticeably faster.

No breaking changes this time, so that heading is left out.
